Congress leader Venugopal reviews Bengal party ahead of elections

Congress leader K.C. Venugopal visited West Bengal to review the party's preparations for upcoming bypolls and civic elections. During his visit, he stated that BJP rule in Bengal would be similar to its governance in other parts of the country, describing it as 'aggressive'. The visit also involved discussions about the party's organizational matters.
